description: This file is a script for analyzing import boundaries related to plugin extensions within a TypeScript project. It contains functions to collect, compare, and format inventory of import boundary violations, specifically focusing on plugin-related files and web search provider plugins.

methods.name: collectPluginExtensionImportBoundaryInventory
methods.description: Collects an inventory of import boundary violations related to plugin extensions, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: readExpectedInventory
methods.description: Reads the baseline expected inventory data from a JSON file, with caching.

methods.name: diffInventory
methods.description: Compares the expected and actual inventory to identify differences.

methods.name: runPluginExtensionImportBoundaryCheck
methods.description: Runs the inventory check and compares results, returning an exit code.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script, handling process exit based on check results.
